limitations: Fixed top/bottom/right control margins can miss messages in unusual layouts
Announcements, usernames and entry notices are intentionally permitted
OCR misses and messages appearing between sampled frames remain possible
Exact-text suppression may skip identical wording after disjoint screen changes; OCR flicker and scrolling may replay text
Speech queue limits: 60 lines, 90 seconds, 2000 characters per line; busy rooms may lag or drop excess entries
Keyboard grid detection cannot cover every keyboard or prediction bar
